data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Benon', meaning 'son of the south'. This name carries the strength and resilience of those who come from a warm and nurturing environment. In the Bible, Benis can be linked to the prophet Benaiah, a valiant warrior of King David. The name Benis carries the meaning “Son of the south” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Benis usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the south and live with faith, good character and purpose.
